items.headline: Jaheim Merriweather runs for 3 touchdowns and Troy defeats Alabama State 34-17
items.description: — Jaheim Merriweather ran for 127 yards and scored three times, leading Troy to a 34-17 victory over Alabama State on Saturday.

items.headline: Crowder throws 3 TD passes and Troy holds off Sam Houston 24-21
items.description: — Goose Crowder threw three touchdown passes and Troy shut out Sam Houston for most of the second half for a 24-21 victory on Saturday night in the season opener for both teams.
